newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Generale Bank gets HK banking licence.
newsitem.headline: Generale Bank gets HK banking licence.

text.p: Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA), the territory's de facto central bank, said on Tuesday it has granted a banking licence to Generale Bank.

A full branch would enable the bank, Belgium's largest banking institution, to conduct its global treasury activities round the clock by operating in the Hong Kong, Brussels and New York financial markets, the HKMA said in a statement.
With the awarding of the licence, the number of banks in the territory rose to 183, 31 of which are locally incorporated, the statement said.
Generale Bank ranks 78th in the world in terms of tier 1 capital and provides full-service banking through 1,100 domestic branches and international subsidiaries, branches and representative offices.
